nodes.label: Karl Jupyter Kernel
nodes.rationale: Provides a Jupyter frontend for Karl so notebook users get code execution, state persistence and error reporting without leaving the Jupyter ecosystem; installed as a kernelspec pointing at the karl binary.

nodes.label: ZeroMQ Kernel Transport (go-zeromq/zmq4)
nodes.rationale: Jupyter's wire protocol is ZeroMQ-based, so the kernel uses github.com/go-zeromq/zmq4 for socket management and message handling in kernel/kernel.go rather than inventing a transport.

nodes.label: Kernel Cross-Cell State Persistence
nodes.rationale: Variables and functions defined in one cell must remain available in subsequent cells for an interactive workflow to be useful.

nodes.label: kernel/install.sh Kernelspec Installer
nodes.rationale: Builds the karl binary and writes kernel.json into ~/Library/Jupyter/kernels/karl so Jupyter discovers Karl automatically instead of requiring manual spec authoring.

hyperedges.label: Persistent-Environment Execution Pattern Shared Across Surfaces
